mapper.select: SELECT b.*,u.display_name AS created_by_name,g.name AS owner_group_name FROM t_knowledge_base b LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id=b.created_by LEFT JOIN t_user_group g ON g.id=b.owner_group_id WHERE b.status<>'ARCHIVED' AND (b.visibility='PUBLIC' OR b.created_by=#{userId} OR (b.owner_group_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_user_group_member m WHERE m.group_id=b.owner_group_id AND m.user_id=#{userId}))) AND b.visibility='PUBLIC' ORDER BY b.created_time DESC

SELECT b.*,u.display_name AS created_by_name,g.name AS owner_group_name FROM t_knowledge_base b LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id=b.created_by LEFT JOIN t_user_group g ON g.id=b.owner_group_id WHERE b.id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_knowledge_base SET status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE t_knowledge_base SET visibility=#{visibility},owner_group_id=#{ownerGroupId} WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT * FROM t_ingestion_run WHERE id=#{runId}

mapper.select: SELECT d.id,d.document_code documentCode,d.title,d.status,d.retry_count retryCount,s.id sourceId,s.name sourceName,s.storage_path storagePath,s.authority_score authorityScore,s.permission_tags permissionTags,s.source_type sourceType,sv.version_no sourceVersion,sv.id sourceVersionId,s.knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,COALESCE((SELECT MAX(cu.revision) FROM t_content_unit cu WHERE cu.document_id=d.id),1) chunkRevision FROM t_document d JOIN t_source_version sv ON sv.id=d.source_version_id JOIN t_source s ON s.id=sv.source_id WHERE d.id=#{id}

mapper.select: SELECT e.evidence_code evidenceCode,e.content_hash evidenceHash,cu.id contentUnitId,cu.unit_code unitCode,cu.heading_path headingPath,cu.chunk_type chunkType,cu.page_no pageNo,cu.page_end pageEnd,cu.char_start charStart,cu.char_end charEnd,cu.revision chunkRevision,cu.status chunkStatus,LEFT(cu.content,240) excerpt,d.id documentId,d.document_code documentCode,d.title documentTitle,d.status documentStatus,s.id sourceId,s.name sourceName,s.source_type sourceType,sv.version_no sourceVersion,s.authority_score authorityScore FROM t_evidence e JOIN t_content_unit cu ON cu.id=e.content_unit_id JOIN t_document d ON d.id=cu.document_id JOIN t_source_version sv ON sv.id=d.source_version_id JOIN t_source s ON s.id=sv.source_id WHERE e.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND e.object_type=#{objectType} AND e.object_code=#{objectCode} ORDER BY e.id

SELECT id FROM t_content_unit WHERE unit_code=#{unitCode}
SELECT id,unit_code unitCode FROM t_content_unit WHERE unit_code IN #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_claim(claim_code,knowledge_base_id,subject,predicate,object_value,condition_json,qualifier_json,polarity,confidence,certainty,status,permission_tags,valid_from,valid_to,version)VALUES(#{claimCode},#{knowledgeBaseId},#{subject},#{predicate},#{objectValue},CAST(#{conditionJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{qualifierJson} AS JSON),#{polarity},#{confidence},#{certainty},#{status},CAST(#{permissionTags} AS JSON),#{validFrom},#{validTo},#{version})

INSERT IGNORE INTO t_claim_evidence(claim_code,evidence_id,support_type,support_score) SELECT #{claimCode},e.id,'SUPPORT',0.80 FROM t_evidence e JOIN t_content_unit cu ON cu.id=e.content_unit_id WHERE cu.document_id=#{documentId}

INSERT IGNORE INTO t_knowledge_evidence(knowledge_code,evidence_id,support_type,support_score) SELECT #{knowledgeCode},e.id,'SUPPORT',0.80 FROM t_evidence e JOIN t_content_unit cu ON cu.id=e.content_unit_id WHERE cu.document_id=#{documentId}
mapper.select: SELECT 'CLAIM' objectType,c.claim_code objectCode,CONCAT(c.subject,' ',c.predicate,' ',c.object_value) objectContent,c.confidence, COUNT(DISTINCT ce.evidence_id) evidenceCount,COUNT(DISTINCT e.source_id) sourceCount,COALESCE(AVG(e.authority_score),0) authorityScore,COALESCE(AVG(e.freshness_score),0) freshnessScore, COALESCE(MAX(cf.conflictCount),0) conflictCount,COALESCE(MAX(cf.maxConflictScore),0) maxConflictScore,c.status FROM t_claim c LEFT JOIN t_claim_evidence ce ON ce.claim_code=c.claim_code LEFT JOIN t_evidence e ON e.id=ce.evidence_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT objectCode,COUNT(*) conflictCount,MAX(conflictScore) maxConflictScore FROM ( SELECT object_a_code objectCode,conflict_score conflictScore FROM t_knowledge_conflict WHERE status='OPEN' UNION ALL SELECT object_b_code objectCode,conflict_score conflictScore FROM t_knowledge_conflict WHERE status='OPEN' ) conflict_rows GROUP BY objectCode ) cf ON cf.objectCode=c.claim_code WHERE c.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND c.status IN ('DRAFT','UNCERTAIN','CONFLICTED','PENDING_REVIEW') GROUP BY c.id UNION ALL SELECT 'CARD' objectType,k.knowledge_code objectCode,CONCAT(k.title,' ',k.content) objectContent,k.confidence, COUNT(DISTINCT ke.evidence_id) evidenceCount,COUNT(DISTINCT e.source_id) sourceCount,COALESCE(AVG(e.authority_score),0) authorityScore,COALESCE(AVG(e.freshness_score),0) freshnessScore,0 conflictCount,0 maxConflictScore,k.status FROM t_knowledge_card k LEFT JOIN t_knowledge_evidence ke ON ke.knowledge_code=k.knowledge_code LEFT JOIN t_evidence e ON e.id=ke.evidence_id WHERE k.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND k.status IN ('DRAFT','UNCERTAIN','CONFLICTED','PENDING_REVIEW') GROUP BY k.id

SELECT 'CARD' objectType,k.id,k.knowledge_code objectCode,k.title,k.type, k.summary,k.content,k.status,k.confidence,k.created_time createdTime,k.updated_time updatedTime FROM t_knowledge_card k WHERE #{objectType}='CARD' AND k.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND k.knowledge_code=#{objectCode} AND (k.permission_tags IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(k.permission_tags)=0
OR (JSON_CONTAINS(k.permission_tags, JSON_QUOTE(#{tag}))) ) UNION ALL SELECT 'CLAIM',c.id,c.claim_code,c.subject,c.predicate, NULL,c.object_value,c.status,c.confidence,c.created_time,c.updated_time FROM t_claim c WHERE #{objectType}='CLAIM' AND c.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND c.claim_code=#{objectCode} AND (c.permission_tags IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(c.permission_tags)=0
OR (JSON_CONTAINS(c.permission_tags, JSON_QUOTE(#{tag}))) )

SELECT id,object_type objectType,object_code objectCode,decision,reviewer, comment_text comment,created_time createdTime FROM t_knowledge_review WHERE object_type=#{objectType} AND object_code=#{objectCode} ORDER BY created_time DESC

SELECT id,object_type objectType,object_code objectCode,policy_version policyVersion, knowledge_confidence knowledgeConfidence,risk_level riskLevel,decision, requires_human_review requiresHumanReview,score_json scoreJson, ai_judge_json aiJudgeJson,reason_text reasonText,created_time createdTime FROM t_adjudication_assessment WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND object_type=#{objectType} AND object_code=#{objectCode} ORDER BY created_time DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT id,object_type objectType,object_code objectCode,version_no versionNo,title,summary,content,status,confidence, change_type changeType,changed_by changedBy,supersedes_version_no supersedesVersionNo,created_time createdTime FROM t_knowledge_version WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND object_type=#{objectType} AND object_code=#{objectCode} ORDER BY version_no DESC

SELECT e.evidence_code evidenceCode,e.quote_text quoteText,e.authority_score authorityScore, e.freshness_score freshnessScore,e.status evidenceStatus, s.source_code sourceCode,s.name sourceName,s.source_type sourceType,s.source_uri sourceUri, d.document_code documentCode,d.title documentTitle,d.mime_type mimeType,d.parse_status parseStatus, cu.unit_code contentUnitCode,cu.heading_path headingPath,cu.page_no pageNo,cu.content content, cu.content_hash contentHash FROM t_content_unit cu JOIN t_document d ON d.id=cu.document_id JOIN t_source_version sv ON sv.id=d.source_version_id JOIN t_source s ON s.id=sv.source_id LEFT JOIN t_evidence e ON e.content_unit_id=cu.id AND e.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND cu.id=#{contentUnitId} AND (s.permission_tags IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(s.permission_tags)=0
OR (JSON_CONTAINS(s.permission_tags, JSON_QUOTE(#{tag}))) ) ORDER BY e.id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT e.evidence_code evidenceCode,e.quote_text quoteText,e.authority_score authorityScore, e.freshness_score freshnessScore,e.location_json locationJson,e.status evidenceStatus, s.source_code sourceCode,s.name sourceName,s.source_type sourceType,s.source_uri sourceUri, d.document_code documentCode,d.title documentTitle,d.mime_type mimeType,d.parse_status parseStatus, cu.unit_code contentUnitCode,cu.heading_path headingPath,cu.page_no pageNo,cu.content content, cu.content_hash contentHash FROM t_evidence e JOIN t_source s ON s.id=e.source_id LEFT JOIN t_content_unit cu ON cu.id=e.content_unit_id LEFT JOIN t_document d ON d.id=cu.document_id WHERE e.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND e.evidence_code=#{evidenceCode} AND (s.permission_tags IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(s.permission_tags)=0
OR (JSON_CONTAINS(s.permission_tags, JSON_QUOTE(#{tag}))) ) LIMIT 1

SELECT e.evidence_code evidenceCode,e.quote_text quoteText,e.authority_score authorityScore, e.freshness_score freshnessScore,s.name sourceName,e.location_json locationJson, cu.unit_code contentUnitCode,cu.heading_path headingPath,cu.page_no pageNo,d.document_code documentCode,d.title documentTitle FROM t_evidence e JOIN t_source s ON s.id=e.source_id LEFT JOIN t_content_unit cu ON cu.id=e.content_unit_id LEFT JOIN t_document d ON d.id=cu.document_id WHERE e.id IN (SELECT evidence_id FROM t_claim_evidence WHERE claim_code=#{objectCode}) AND #{objectType}='CLAIM' UNION ALL SELECT e.evidence_code,e.quote_text,e.authority_score,e.freshness_score,s.name,e.location_json, cu.unit_code,cu.heading_path,cu.page_no,d.document_code,d.title FROM t_evidence e JOIN t_source s ON s.id=e.source_id LEFT JOIN t_content_unit cu ON cu.id=e.content_unit_id LEFT JOIN t_document d ON d.id=cu.document_id WHERE e.id IN (SELECT evidence_id FROM t_knowledge_evidence WHERE knowledge_code=#{objectCode}) AND #{objectType}='CARD' LIMIT 8

SELECT evidenceCode,evidenceHash FROM ( (SELECT e.evidence_code evidenceCode,COALESCE(cu.content_hash,'') evidenceHash FROM t_knowledge_evidence k JOIN t_evidence e ON e.id=k.evidence_id LEFT JOIN t_content_unit cu ON cu.id=e.content_unit_id WHERE k.knowledge_code=#{objectCode} AND #{objectType}='CARD' ORDER BY e.id ASC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT e.evidence_code evidenceCode,COALESCE(cu.content_hash,'') evidenceHash FROM t_claim_evidence c JOIN t_evidence e ON e.id=c.evidence_id LEFT JOIN t_content_unit cu ON cu.id=e.content_unit_id WHERE c.claim_code=#{objectCode} AND #{objectType}='CLAIM' ORDER BY e.id ASC LIMIT 1) ) x LIMIT 1

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_adjudication_assessment(knowledge_base_id,object_type,object_code,policy_version,knowledge_confidence,risk_level,decision,requires_human_review,score_json,ai_judge_json,reason_text) VALUES(#{kb},#{objectType},#{objectCode},#{policyVersion},#{confidence},#{riskLevel},#{decision},#{requiresHuman},CAST(#{scoreJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{aiJson} AS JSON),#{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT id,object_type objectType,object_code objectCode,policy_version policyVersion,knowledge_confidence knowledgeConfidence,risk_level riskLevel,decision,requires_human_review requiresHumanReview,score_json scoreJson,ai_judge_json aiJudgeJson,reason_text reasonText,created_time createdTime FROM t_adjudication_assessment WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} ORDER BY created_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM t_knowledge_card WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND (permission_tags IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(permission_tags)=0 OR JSON_CONTAINS(permission_tags, JSON_QUOTE(#{tag}))) AND (permission_tags IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(permission_tags)=0) ORDER BY updated_time DESC

SELECT * FROM t_claim WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND (permission_tags IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(permission_tags)=0 OR JSON_CONTAINS(permission_tags, JSON_QUOTE(#{tag}))) AND (permission_tags IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(permission_tags)=0) ORDER BY updated_time DESC
SELECT * FROM t_claim WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND subject IN #{subject} AND 1=0

SELECT s.id sourceId,s.source_code sourceCode,s.name name,s.source_type sourceType,s.source_uri sourceUri, s.storage_path storagePath,s.authority_score authorityScore,s.status status,s.created_time createdTime, d.id documentId,d.document_code documentCode,d.title documentTitle,d.mime_type mimeType, d.parse_status parseStatus,d.chunk_count chunkCount,d.raw_text rawText FROM t_source s LEFT JOIN t_source_version sv ON sv.source_id=s.id AND sv.version_no=1 LEFT JOIN t_document d ON d.source_version_id=sv.id WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND s.id=#{sourceId} AND (s.permission_tags IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(s.permission_tags)=0
OR (JSON_CONTAINS(s.permission_tags, JSON_QUOTE(#{tag}))) ) LIMIT 1

SELECT d.id,d.document_code documentCode,d.title,d.mime_type mimeType,d.parse_status parseStatus,d.status,d.current_stage currentStage,d.error_message errorMessage,d.retry_count retryCount,d.chunk_count chunkCount,s.name sourceName,s.id sourceId,d.created_time createdTime FROM t_document d JOIN t_source_version sv ON sv.id=d.source_version_id JOIN t_source s ON s.id=sv.source_id WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} ORDER BY d.created_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_knowledge_card SET status=#{status} WHERE knowledge_code=#{code}
UPDATE t_claim SET status=#{status} WHERE claim_code=#{code}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,c.object_a_code objectACode,c.object_b_code objectBCode, c.conflict_type conflictType,c.conflict_score conflictScore,c.status,c.resolution,c.created_time createdTime, a.objectType objectAType,a.displayTitle objectATitle,a.content objectAContent,a.status objectAStatus,a.confidence objectAConfidence,a.versionNo objectAVersion, b.objectType objectBType,b.displayTitle objectBTitle,b.content objectBContent,b.status objectBStatus,b.confidence objectBConfidence,b.versionNo objectBVersion FROM t_knowledge_conflict c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT 'CARD' objectType,knowledge_code code,title displayTitle,CONCAT(title,'：',LEFT(COALESCE(summary,content),200)) content,status,confidence,version versionNo FROM t_knowledge_card UNION ALL SELECT 'CLAIM' objectType,claim_code code,CONCAT(subject,' ',predicate,' ',LEFT(object_value,120)) displayTitle,CONCAT(subject,' ',predicate,' ',object_value) content,status,confidence, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(v.version_no) FROM t_knowledge_version v WHERE v.object_type='CLAIM' AND v.object_code=cv.claim_code),1) versionNo FROM t_claim cv ) a ON a.code=c.object_a_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT 'CARD' objectType,knowledge_code code,title displayTitle,CONCAT(title,'：',LEFT(COALESCE(summary,content),200)) content,status,confidence,version versionNo FROM t_knowledge_card UNION ALL SELECT 'CLAIM' objectType,claim_code code,CONCAT(subject,' ',predicate,' ',LEFT(object_value,120)) displayTitle,CONCAT(subject,' ',predicate,' ',object_value) content,status,confidence, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(v.version_no) FROM t_knowledge_version v WHERE v.object_type='CLAIM' AND v.object_code=cv.claim_code),1) versionNo FROM t_claim cv ) b ON b.code=c.object_b_code WHERE c.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND (#{status} IS NULL OR c.status=#{status}) ORDER BY c.conflict_score DESC,c.created_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_knowledge_conflict SET status=#{status},resolution=#{resolution},updated_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id,knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,object_a_code objectACode,object_b_code objectBCode,conflict_type conflictType,conflict_score conflictScore,status,resolution,created_time createdTime FROM t_knowledge_conflict WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT 'CLAIM' objectType,claim_code objectCode,CONCAT(subject,' ',predicate,' ',LEFT(object_value,200)) content,condition_json conditionJson,confidence,status,COALESCE((SELECT MAX(v.version_no) FROM t_knowledge_version v WHERE v.object_type='CLAIM' AND v.object_code=claim_code),1) versionNo FROM t_claim WHERE claim_code IN #{code} UNION ALL SELECT 'CARD' objectType,knowledge_code objectCode,CONCAT(title,'：',LEFT(COALESCE(summary,content),200)) content,NULL conditionJson,confidence,status,COALESCE(version,1) versionNo FROM t_knowledge_card WHERE knowledge_code IN #{code}

SELECT pending.* FROM ( SELECT 'CARD' objectType,t.knowledge_code objectCode,t.title displayTitle,t.confidence,t.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_knowledge_conflict c WHERE c.status='OPEN' AND (c.object_a_code=t.knowledge_code OR c.object_b_code=t.knowledge_code)) conflictCount FROM t_knowledge_card t WHERE t.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND t.status IN ('DRAFT','UNCERTAIN','CONFLICTED','PENDING_REVIEW') UNION ALL SELECT 'CLAIM' objectType,t.claim_code objectCode,CONCAT(t.subject,' ',t.predicate,' ',LEFT(t.object_value,120)) displayTitle,t.confidence,t.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_knowledge_conflict c WHERE c.status='OPEN' AND (c.object_a_code=t.claim_code OR c.object_b_code=t.claim_code)) conflictCount FROM t_claim t WHERE t.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND t.status IN ('DRAFT','UNCERTAIN','CONFLICTED','PENDING_REVIEW') ) pending ORDER BY CASE WHEN pending.status='CONFLICTED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,pending.conflictCount DESC,pending.confidence ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_query_trace(query_id,knowledge_base_id,trace_id,original_query,rewritten_queries_json,router_decision_json,retrieval_json,fusion_json,rerank_json,selected_context_json,citations_json,model_name,latency_ms,token_usage_json,error_code,trace_json,answer) VALUES(#{queryId},#{knowledgeBaseId},#{traceId},#{originalQuery},CAST(#{rewrittenQueriesJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{routerDecisionJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{retrievalJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{fusionJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{rerankJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{selectedContextJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{citationsJson} AS JSON),#{modelName},#{latencyMs},CAST(#{tokenUsageJson} AS JSON),#{errorCode},CAST(#{traceJson} AS JSON),#{answer})

mapper.select: SELECT id,query_id queryId,knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,trace_id traceId,original_query originalQuery,rewritten_queries_json rewrittenQueriesJson,router_decision_json routerDecisionJson,retrieval_json retrievalJson,fusion_json fusionJson,rerank_json rerankJson,selected_context_json selectedContextJson,citations_json citationsJson,model_name modelName,latency_ms latencyMs,token_usage_json tokenUsageJson,error_code errorCode,trace_json traceJson,pipeline_json pipelineJson,answer,created_time createdTime FROM t_query_trace WHERE query_id=#{qid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_answer_claim_assessment(query_id,claim_id,policy_version,statement_text,decision,confidence,entailment_score,citation_indexes_json,evidence_codes_json,evidence_statuses_json,included_in_final_answer) VALUES(#{queryId},#{claimId},#{policyVersion},#{statement},#{decision},#{confidence},#{entailmentScore},CAST(#{citationIndexesJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{evidenceCodesJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{evidenceStatusesJson} AS JSON),#{included})
mapper.select: SELECT query_id queryId,knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,policy_version policyVersion, gate_status gateStatus,evidence_gate_status evidenceGateStatus,structured_gate_status structuredGateStatus, decision_reasons_json decisionReasonsJson,original_answer_hash originalAnswerHash, delivered_answer_hash deliveredAnswerHash,claim_count claimCount,created_time createdTime FROM t_answer_qualification WHERE query_id=#{queryId}

SELECT claim_id claimId,policy_version policyVersion,statement_text statement,decision,confidence, entailment_score entailmentScore,citation_indexes_json citationIndexesJson,evidence_codes_json evidenceIdsJson, evidence_statuses_json evidenceStatusesJson,included_in_final_answer includedInFinalAnswer,created_time createdTime FROM t_answer_claim_assessment WHERE query_id=#{queryId} ORDER BY id

SELECT COUNT(*) totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(gate_status='PASS'),0) passCount,COALESCE(SUM(gate_status='PARTIAL'),0) partialCount, COALESCE(SUM(gate_status='BLOCKED'),0) blockedCount,COALESCE(SUM(gate_status='BYPASSED'),0) bypassedCount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(gate_status='PASS'),5),0) passRate, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(gate_status='BLOCKED'),5),0) blockedRate, COUNT(DISTINCT policy_version) policyVersionCount FROM t_answer_qualification WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND created_time>=TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR,-#{hours},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

SELECT policy_version policyVersion,COUNT(*) totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(gate_status='PASS'),0) passCount,COALESCE(SUM(gate_status='PARTIAL'),0) partialCount, COALESCE(SUM(gate_status='BLOCKED'),0) blockedCount,COALESCE(SUM(gate_status='BYPASSED'),0) bypassedCount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(gate_status='PASS'),5),0) passRate,MAX(created_time) latestTime FROM t_answer_qualification WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND created_time>=TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR,-#{hours},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY policy_version ORDER BY latestTime DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_index_aggregate_version(aggregate_key,current_version) VALUES(#{aggregateKey},1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE current_version=current_version+1
mapper.select: SELECT current_version FROM t_index_aggregate_version WHERE aggregate_key=#{aggregateKey}
SELECT * FROM t_index_outbox WHERE idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
SELECT * FROM t_index_outbox WHERE event_id=#{eventId}

SELECT o.* FROM t_index_outbox o WHERE o.status IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND o.next_attempt_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_index_outbox older WHERE older.aggregate_key=o.aggregate_key AND older.object_version<o.object_version AND older.status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','SKIPPED') ) ORDER BY o.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE t_index_outbox SET status='PROCESSING',attempt_count=attempt_count+1,locked_by=#{workerId},locked_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','RETRY')

UPDATE t_index_outbox SET status='SUCCEEDED',result_json=CAST(#{resultJson} AS JSON),last_error=NULL,locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL,processed_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE t_index_outbox SET status='RETRY',last_error=#{error},next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt},locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE t_index_outbox SET status='DEAD',last_error=#{error},locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL,processed_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE t_index_outbox SET status='RETRY',next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL,last_error=CONCAT('Recovered stale lock; ',COALESCE(last_error,'')) WHERE status='PROCESSING' AND locked_at<#{threshold}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO t_index_delivery_attempt(event_id,attempt_no,status,duration_ms,response_json,error_text) VALUES(#{eventId},#{attemptNo},#{status},#{durationMs},CASE WHEN #{responseJson} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(#{responseJson} AS JSON) END,#{errorText})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_index_outbox WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND status=#{status}

SELECT COUNT(*) total, SUM(status='PENDING') pending, SUM(status='PROCESSING') processing, SUM(status='RETRY') retryCount, SUM(status='SUCCEEDED') succeeded, SUM(status='DEAD') dead, SUM(status='SKIPPED') skipped, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,MIN(CASE WHEN status IN ('PENDING','RETRY','PROCESSING') THEN created_time END),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) oldestLagSeconds FROM t_index_outbox WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_index_outbox SET status='RETRY',attempt_count=0,next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL,last_error=NULL,processed_time=NULL WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND status IN ('DEAD','RETRY')
UPDATE t_index_outbox SET status='SKIPPED',locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL,processed_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND status IN ('DEAD','RETRY','PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT knowledge_base_id FROM t_claim WHERE claim_code=#{objectCode} AND UPPER(#{objectType})='CLAIM' UNION ALL SELECT knowledge_base_id FROM t_knowledge_card WHERE knowledge_code=#{objectCode} AND UPPER(#{objectType})!='CLAIM' LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_content_unit cu JOIN t_document d ON d.id=cu.document_id JOIN t_source_version sv ON sv.id=d.source_version_id JOIN t_source s ON s.id=sv.source_id WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) +(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_knowledge_card WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND status IN ('APPROVED','EFFECTIVE')) +(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_claim WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND status IN ('APPROVED','EFFECTIVE'))

SELECT cu.id content_unit_id,cu.page_no,cu.heading_path,cu.content,cu.content_hash, (SELECT e.evidence_code FROM t_evidence e WHERE e.content_unit_id=cu.id ORDER BY e.id ASC LIMIT 1) evidence_code, cu.content_hash evidence_hash FROM t_content_unit cu WHERE cu.document_id=#{documentId} ORDER BY cu.id

SELECT SUM(status='PENDING') pending,SUM(status='RETRY') retryCount,SUM(status='DEAD') dead, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,MIN(CASE WHEN status IN ('PENDING','RETRY','PROCESSING') THEN created_time END),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) oldestLagSeconds FROM t_index_outbox
mapper.delete: DELETE a FROM t_index_delivery_attempt a JOIN t_index_outbox_archive o ON o.event_id=a.event_id WHERE o.processed_time<#{cutoff}

DELETE FROM t_index_outbox WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM (SELECT o.id FROM t_index_outbox o JOIN t_index_outbox_archive a ON a.id=o.id WHERE o.status IN ('SUCCEEDED','SKIPPED') AND o.processed_time<#{cutoff} ORDER BY o.id LIMIT #{limit}) x)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_index_schema_release WHERE release_id=#{releaseId}

UPDATE t_index_schema_release SET state=CASE WHEN release_id=#{releaseId} THEN 'ACTIVE' WHEN state='ACTIVE' THEN 'RETIRED' ELSE state END, activated_time=CASE WHEN release_id=#{releaseId} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE activated_time END,retired_time=CASE WHEN state='ACTIVE' AND release_id<>#{releaseId} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE retired_time END WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND (release_id=#{releaseId} OR state='ACTIVE')
UPDATE t_index_schema_release SET generation_id=#{generationId},acl_manifest_hash=#{manifestHash},acl_manifest_count=#{objectCount} WHERE release_id=#{releaseId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id),0) FROM t_index_outbox WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}

permissionTags, (SELECT e.evidence_code FROM t_claim_evidence ce JOIN t_evidence e ON e.id=ce.evidence_id WHERE ce.claim_code=cl.claim_code ORDER BY e.id ASC LIMIT 1) evidenceCode, (SELECT SELECT DISTINCT permission_tag FROM ( SELECT st.permission_tag FROM t_acl_subject s JOIN t_acl_subject_tag st ON st.subject_id=s.id WHERE s.subject_code=#{subjectCode} AND s.status='ACTIVE' UNION ALL SELECT rt.permission_tag FROM t_acl_subject s JOIN t_acl_subject_role sr ON sr.subject_id=s.id JOIN t_acl_role r ON r.id=sr.role_id AND r.status='ACTIVE' JOIN t_acl_role_tag rt ON rt.role_id=r.id WHERE s.subject_code=#{subjectCode} AND s.status='ACTIVE' UNION ALL SELECT dt.permission_tag FROM t_acl_subject s JOIN t_acl_department_tag dt ON dt.department_code=s.department_code WHERE s.subject_code=#{subjectCode} AND s.status='ACTIVE' ) x ORDER BY permission_tag
SELECT subject_code subjectCode,display_name displayName,department_code departmentCode,status FROM t_acl_subject ORDER BY subject_code
SELECT role_code roleCode,role_name roleName,status FROM t_acl_role ORDER BY role_code

SELECT id,subject_code subjectCode,knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,resource_type resourceType,resource_code resourceCode,action_name actionName,decision,permission_tags permissionTags,reason,trace_id traceId,request_uri requestUri,created_time createdTime FROM t_acl_access_audit WHERE (#{kb} IS NULL OR knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT CASE WHEN #{type}='SOURCE' THEN (SELECT CAST(permission_tags AS CHAR) FROM t_source WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND source_code=#{code}) WHEN #{type}='CARD' THEN (SELECT CAST(permission_tags AS CHAR) FROM t_knowledge_card WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND knowledge_code=#{code}) WHEN #{type}='CLAIM' THEN (SELECT CAST(permission_tags AS CHAR) FROM t_claim WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND claim_code=#{code}) END

choose.when: UPDATE t_source SET permission_tags=CAST(#{tagsJson} AS JSON) WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND source_code=#{code}
UPDATE t_knowledge_card SET permission_tags=CAST(#{tagsJson} AS JSON) WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND knowledge_code=#{code}
UPDATE t_claim SET permission_tags=CAST(#{tagsJson} AS JSON) WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND claim_code=#{code}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_acl_change(change_code,knowledge_base_id,resource_type,resource_code,old_permission_tags,new_permission_tags,changed_by,impact_json) VALUES(#{changeCode},#{kb},#{type},#{code},CAST(#{oldTags} AS JSON),CAST(#{newTags} AS JSON),#{changedBy},CAST(#{impactJson} AS JSON))
mapper.update: UPDATE t_acl_change SET propagation_state=#{state}, propagation_result=CASE WHEN #{resultJson} IS NULL THEN propagation_result ELSE CAST(#{resultJson} AS JSON) END, last_error=#{lastError}, completed_time=CASE WHEN #{state} IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE completed_time END WHERE change_code=#{changeCode}
mapper.select: SELECT change_code changeCode,knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,resource_type resourceType,resource_code resourceCode,propagation_state propagationState FROM t_acl_change WHERE change_code=#{changeCode}

SELECT id,job_code jobCode,change_code changeCode,knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,schema_version schemaVersion,release_id releaseId,state,qualification_state qualificationState,error_text errorText,created_time createdTime,updated_time updatedTime,completed_time completedTime FROM t_acl_rebuild_job WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_acl_rebuild_job SET state=#{state},release_id=COALESCE(#{releaseId},release_id),qualification_state=COALESCE(#{qualificationState},qualification_state),qualification_json=CASE WHEN #{qualificationJson} IS NULL THEN qualification_json ELSE CAST(#{qualificationJson} AS JSON) END,error_text=#{errorText},completed_time=CASE WHEN #{state} IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE completed_time END WHERE job_code=#{jobCode}

permissionTags,SHA2(CONCAT_WS('|',e.entity_code,COALESCE(e.entity_type,''),COALESCE(e.canonical_name,''),COALESCE(e.description,''),COALESCE(e.status,''),COALESCE(CAST(e.permission_tags AS CHAR),'[]')),256) contentHash FROM t_entity e WHERE e.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND (e.status IS NULL OR e.status IN ('APPROVED','EFFECTIVE','ACTIVE')) UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('RELATION:',r.relation_code),'RELATION',r.relation_code,se.entity_code,te.entity_code,r.relation_type,NULL,NULL,r.status,COALESCE(CAST(r.permission_tags AS CHAR),'[]'),SHA2(CONCAT_WS('|',r.relation_code,se.entity_code,r.relation_type,te.entity_code,COALESCE(r.status,''),COALESCE(CAST(r.permission_tags AS CHAR),'[]')),256) FROM t_relation r JOIN t_entity se ON se.id=r.source_entity_id JOIN t_entity te ON te.id=r.target_entity_id WHERE r.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND (r.status IS NULL OR r.status IN ('APPROVED','EFFECTIVE','ACTIVE')) UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('CLAIM_ENTITY:',ce.claim_code,':',ce.entity_code),'CLAIM_ENTITY',CONCAT(ce.claim_code,':',ce.entity_code),ce.claim_code,ce.entity_code,ce.relation_role,NULL,NULL,c.status,COALESCE(CAST(ce.permission_tags FROM t_claim_entity ce JOIN t_claim c ON c.claim_code=ce.claim_code WHERE c.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND c.status IN ('APPROVED','EFFECTIVE') UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('CARD_ENTITY:',ce.knowledge_code,':',ce.entity_code),'CARD_ENTITY',CONCAT(ce.knowledge_code,':',ce.entity_code),ce.knowledge_code,ce.entity_code,ce.relation_role,NULL,NULL,c.status,COALESCE(CAST(ce.permission_tags AS CHAR),CAST(c.permission_tags AS CHAR),'[]'),SHA2(CONCAT_WS('|',ce.knowledge_code,ce.entity_code,ce.relation_role,COALESCE(CAST(ce.permission_tags AS CHAR),CAST(c.permission_tags AS CHAR),'[]')),256) FROM t_card_entity ce JOIN t_knowledge_card c ON c.knowledge_code=ce.knowledge_code WHERE c.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND c.status IN ('APPROVED','EFFECTIVE') UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('ENTITY_FACET:',f.facet_code),'ENTITY_FACET',f.facet_code,f.entity_code,NULL,f.entity_type,f.facet_name,f.facet_description,f.status,COALESCE(CAST(f.permission_tags AS CHAR),'[]'),SHA2(CONCAT_WS('|',f.facet_code,f.entity_code,COALESCE(f.facet_name,''),COALESCE(f.facet_description,''),COALESCE(CAST(f.permission_tags AS CHAR),'[]')),256) FROM t_entity_facet f WHERE f.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND f.status='ACTIVE' UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('RELATION_FACET:',f.facet_code),'RELATION_FACET',f.facet_code,f.source_entity_code,f.target_entity_code,f.relation_type,NULL,NULL,f.status,COALESCE(CAST(f.permission_tags AS CHAR),'[]'),SHA2(CONCAT_WS('|',f.facet_code,f.relation_code,f.source_entity_code,f.target_entity_code,COALESCE(CAST(f.permission_tags AS CHAR),'[]')),256) FROM t_relation_facet f WHERE f.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND f.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY graphKey

SELECT f.facet_code facetCode,e.evidence_code evidenceCode,s.source_code sourceCode,sv.version_no sourceVersion,COALESCE(CAST(s.permission_tags AS CHAR),'[]') permissionTags,SHA2(CONCAT_WS('|',e.evidence_code,COALESCE(e.quote_text,''),COALESCE(CAST(e.location_json AS CHAR),'')),256) evidenceHash,COALESCE(CAST(e.location_json AS CHAR),'{}') locator FROM t_entity_facet f JOIN t_source s ON s.id=f.source_id JOIN t_evidence e ON e.source_id=f.source_id LEFT JOIN t_source_version sv ON sv.source_id=s.id AND sv.status IN ('ACTIVE','EFFECTIVE') WHERE f.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND f.status='ACTIVE' AND e.status IN ('APPROVED','EFFECTIVE','ACTIVE') UNION ALL SELECT f.facet_code,e.evidence_code,s.source_code,sv.version_no,COALESCE(CAST(s.permission_tags AS CHAR),'[]'),SHA2(CONCAT_WS('|',e.evidence_code,COALESCE(e.quote_text,''),COALESCE(CAST(e.location_json AS CHAR),'')),256),COALESCE(CAST(e.location_json AS CHAR),'{}') FROM t_relation_facet f JOIN t_source s ON s.id=f.source_id JOIN t_evidence e ON e.source_id=f.source_id LEFT JOIN t_source_version sv ON sv.source_id=s.id AND sv.status IN ('ACTIVE','EFFECTIVE') WHERE f.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND f.status='ACTIVE' AND e.status IN ('APPROVED','EFFECTIVE','ACTIVE') ORDER BY facetCode,evidenceCode
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_entity WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND (status IS NULL OR status IN ('APPROVED','EFFECTIVE','ACTIVE'))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_relation WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND (status IS NULL OR status IN ('APPROVED','EFFECTIVE','ACTIVE'))

SELECT release_id releaseId,knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,generation_id generationId,manifest_hash manifestHash,entity_count entityCount,relation_count relationCount FROM t_index_graph_manifest WHERE release_id=#{releaseId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_entity(entity_code,knowledge_base_id,source_id,entity_type,canonical_name,description,confidence,status,permission_tags,acl_inherited_from) VALUES(#{code},#{kb},#{sourceId},#{type},#{name},#{description},#{confidence},#{status},CAST(#{tagsJson} AS JSON),#{aclFrom}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_id=VALUES(source_id),entity_type=VALUES(entity_type),canonical_name=VALUES(canonical_name),description=VALUES(description),confidence=VALUES(confidence),status=VALUES(status),permission_tags=VALUES(permission_tags),acl_inherited_from=VALUES(acl_inherited_from)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_entity WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND entity_code=#{code} LIMIT 1
SELECT id id,entity_code entityCode FROM t_entity WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND (entity_code=#{value} OR canonical_name=#{value}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN status='MERGED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_relation(relation_code,knowledge_base_id,source_id,source_entity_id,relation_type,target_entity_id,confidence,status,permission_tags,acl_inherited_from) VALUES(#{code},#{kb},#{sourceId},#{sourceEntityId},#{type},#{targetEntityId},#{confidence},#{status},CAST(#{tagsJson} AS JSON),#{aclFrom}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_id=VALUES(source_id),source_entity_id=VALUES(source_entity_id),relation_type=VALUES(relation_type),target_entity_id=VALUES(target_entity_id),confidence=VALUES(confidence),status=VALUES(status),permission_tags=VALUES(permission_tags),acl_inherited_from=VALUES(acl_inherited_from)

INSERT INTO t_claim_entity(claim_code,entity_code,relation_role,permission_tags) VALUES(#{claimCode},#{entityCode},#{role},CAST(#{tagsJson} AS JSON)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE permission_tags=VALUES(permission_tags)

INSERT INTO t_card_entity(knowledge_code,entity_code,relation_role,permission_tags) VALUES(#{knowledgeCode},#{entityCode},#{role},CAST(#{tagsJson} AS JSON)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE permission_tags=VALUES(permission_tags)

INSERT INTO t_entity_acl_scope(knowledge_base_id,entity_code,source_id,document_id,permission_tags,scope_hash,evidence_origin) VALUES(#{kb},#{entityCode},#{sourceId},#{documentId},CAST(#{tagsJson} AS JSON),#{scopeHash},#{origin}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE document_id=VALUES(document_id),evidence_origin=VALUES(evidence_origin)
mapper.update: UPDATE t_entity e SET e.acl_merge_policy=CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT scope_hash) FROM t_entity_acl_scope s WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND s.entity_code=#{entityCode}) > 1 THEN 'EVIDENCE_SCOPED' ELSE 'SINGLE_SCOPE' END,e.permission_tags=CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT scope_hash) FROM t_entity_acl_scope s WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND s.entity_code=#{entityCode}) > 1 THEN JSON_ARRAY('__evidence_scoped__') ELSE COALESCE((SELECT permission_tags FROM t_entity_acl_scope s WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND s.entity_code=#{entityCode} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1),JSON_ARRAY()) END WHERE e.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND e.entity_code=#{entityCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_relation_acl_scope(knowledge_base_id,relation_code,source_id,document_id,permission_tags,scope_hash,evidence_origin) VALUES(#{kb},#{relationCode},#{sourceId},#{documentId},CAST(#{tagsJson} AS JSON),#{scopeHash},#{origin}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE document_id=VALUES(document_id),evidence_origin=VALUES(evidence_origin)
mapper.update: UPDATE t_relation r SET r.acl_merge_policy=CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT scope_hash) FROM t_relation_acl_scope s WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND s.relation_code=#{relationCode}) > 1 THEN 'EVIDENCE_SCOPED' ELSE 'SINGLE_SCOPE' END,r.permission_tags=CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT scope_hash) FROM t_relation_acl_scope s WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND s.relation_code=#{relationCode}) > 1 THEN JSON_ARRAY('__evidence_scoped__') ELSE COALESCE((SELECT permission_tags FROM t_relation_acl_scope s WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND s.relation_code=#{relationCode} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1),JSON_ARRAY()) END WHERE r.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND r.relation_code=#{relationCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_entity_facet(knowledge_base_id,entity_code,facet_code,source_id,document_id,entity_type,facet_name,facet_description,permission_tags,scope_hash,evidence_origin) VALUES(#{kb},#{entityCode},#{facetCode},#{sourceId},#{documentId},#{type},#{name},#{description},CAST(#{tagsJson} AS JSON),#{scopeHash},#{origin}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE facet_name=VALUES(facet_name),facet_description=VALUES(facet_description),permission_tags=VALUES(permission_tags),evidence_origin=VALUES(evidence_origin),status='ACTIVE'

INSERT INTO t_relation_facet(knowledge_base_id,relation_code,facet_code,source_id,document_id,source_entity_code,target_entity_code,relation_type,permission_tags,scope_hash,evidence_origin) VALUES(#{kb},#{relationCode},#{facetCode},#{sourceId},#{documentId},#{sourceCode},#{targetCode},#{type},CAST(#{tagsJson} AS JSON),#{scopeHash},#{origin}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_entity_code=VALUES(source_entity_code),target_entity_code=VALUES(target_entity_code),relation_type=VALUES(relation_type),permission_tags=VALUES(permission_tags),evidence_origin=VALUES(evidence_origin),status='ACTIVE'

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_entity_alias(knowledge_base_id,entity_code,alias,alias_type,confidence) VALUES(#{kb},#{entityCode},#{alias},#{aliasType},#{confidence}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE alias_type=VALUES(alias_type),confidence=VALUES(confidence)

SELECT claim_code claimCode,valid_from validFrom,valid_to validTo,status FROM t_claim WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND (valid_from IS NOT NULL OR valid_to IS NOT NULL)
SELECT status,COUNT(*) total FROM t_claim WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} GROUP BY status
SELECT status,COUNT(*) total FROM t_knowledge_card WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} GROUP BY status

SELECT e.evidence_code sourceCode,s.source_code targetCode,'EXTRACTED_FROM' edgeType,'PROVENANCE' semanticType,e.authority_score confidence FROM t_evidence e JOIN t_source s ON s.id=e.source_id WHERE e.knowledge_base_id=#{kb}

SELECT ce.claim_code sourceCode,ce.entity_code targetCode,'MENTIONS' edgeType,COALESCE(ce.relation_role,'SUBJECT') semanticType,NULL confidence FROM t_claim_entity ce JOIN t_claim c ON c.claim_code=ce.claim_code WHERE c.knowledge_base_id=#{kb}

SELECT ce.knowledge_code sourceCode,ce.entity_code targetCode,'MENTIONS' edgeType,COALESCE(ce.relation_role,'SUBJECT') semanticType,NULL confidence FROM t_card_entity ce JOIN t_knowledge_card k ON k.knowledge_code=ce.knowledge_code WHERE k.knowledge_base_id=#{kb}

SELECT se.entity_code sourceCode,te.entity_code targetCode,r.relation_type edgeType,r.relation_type semanticType,r.confidence confidence FROM t_relation r JOIN t_entity se ON se.id=r.source_entity_id JOIN t_entity te ON te.id=r.target_entity_id WHERE r.knowledge_base_id=#{kb}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_source WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) sources, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_document d JOIN t_source_version v ON v.id=d.source_version_id JOIN t_source s ON s.id=v.source_id WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) documents, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_content_unit u JOIN t_document d ON d.id=u.document_id JOIN t_source_version v ON v.id=d.source_version_id JOIN t_source s ON s.id=v.source_id WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) contentUnits, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_knowledge_card WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) cards, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_claim WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) claims, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_evidence WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) evidence, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_entity WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) entities, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_relation WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) relations, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_knowledge_conflict WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) conflicts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_index_outbox WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) outboxEvents, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_query_trace WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) queryTraces, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_ingestion_run WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) ingestionRuns
SELECT storage_path FROM t_source WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND storage_path IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(storage_path) > 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ${table} WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}
DELETE FROM t_source_version WHERE source_id IN (SELECT id FROM t_source WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb})
DELETE FROM t_document WHERE source_version_id IN (SELECT v.id FROM t_source_version v JOIN t_source s ON s.id=v.source_id WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb})
DELETE FROM t_content_unit WHERE document_id IN (SELECT d.id FROM t_document d JOIN t_source_version v ON v.id=d.source_version_id JOIN t_source s ON s.id=v.source_id WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb})

DELETE FROM t_knowledge_evidence WHERE knowledge_code IN (SELECT knowledge_code FROM t_knowledge_card WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) OR evidence_id IN (SELECT id FROM t_evidence WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb})
DELETE FROM t_claim_evidence WHERE claim_code IN (SELECT claim_code FROM t_claim WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) OR evidence_id IN (SELECT id FROM t_evidence WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb})

DELETE FROM t_card_entity WHERE knowledge_code IN (SELECT knowledge_code FROM t_knowledge_card WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) OR entity_code IN (SELECT entity_code FROM t_entity WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb})
DELETE FROM t_claim_entity WHERE claim_code IN (SELECT claim_code FROM t_claim WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) OR entity_code IN (SELECT entity_code FROM t_entity WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb})

DELETE FROM t_knowledge_review WHERE object_code IN (SELECT knowledge_code FROM t_knowledge_card WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) OR object_code IN (SELECT claim_code FROM t_claim WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb})
DELETE FROM t_ingestion_event WHERE run_id IN (SELECT id FROM t_ingestion_run WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb})

DELETE FROM t_index_delivery_attempt WHERE event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM t_index_outbox WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) OR event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM t_index_outbox_archive WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb})

DELETE FROM t_index_delivery_attempt_archive WHERE event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM t_index_outbox WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) OR event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM t_index_outbox_archive WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb})
DELETE FROM t_answer_claim_assessment WHERE query_id IN (SELECT query_id FROM t_query_trace WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb})

DELETE FROM t_entity_facet_evidence WHERE facet_code IN (SELECT facet_code FROM t_entity_facet WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) OR evidence_id IN (SELECT id FROM t_evidence WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb})

DELETE FROM t_relation_facet_evidence WHERE facet_code IN (SELECT facet_code FROM t_relation_facet WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) OR evidence_id IN (SELECT id FROM t_evidence WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb})
mapper.select: SELECT id,dataset_code datasetCode,knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,name,description,version,status,created_by createdBy,created_time createdTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_evaluation_case c WHERE c.dataset_id=t_evaluation_dataset.id AND c.status='ACTIVE') caseCount FROM t_evaluation_dataset WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id,dataset_code datasetCode,knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,name,description,version,status,created_by createdBy,created_time createdTime FROM t_evaluation_dataset WHERE dataset_code=#{code}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_evaluation_dataset SET name=#{name},description=#{description},status=#{status} WHERE dataset_code=#{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_evaluation_case(case_code,dataset_id,question,expected_object_codes_json,expected_evidence_codes_json,expected_answer,tags_json,difficulty,version,status) VALUES(#{caseCode},#{datasetId},#{question},CAST(#{expectedObjectCodesJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{expectedEvidenceCodesJson} AS JSON),#{expectedAnswer},CAST(#{tagsJson} AS JSON),#{difficulty},#{version},#{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id,case_code caseCode,dataset_id datasetId,question,expected_object_codes_json expectedObjectCodesJson, expected_evidence_codes_json expectedEvidenceCodesJson,expected_answer expectedAnswer,tags_json tagsJson,difficulty,version,status,created_time createdTime FROM t_evaluation_case WHERE dataset_id=#{datasetId} AND status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_evaluation_case WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_evaluation_run SET status=#{status},policy_version=#{policyVersion},case_count=#{caseCount}, hit_at1_rate=#{hitAt1Rate},hit_at3_rate=#{hitAt3Rate},hit_at5_rate=#{hitAt5Rate},recall_at5=#{recallAt5}, mrr=#{mrr},ndcg_at10=#{ndcgAt10},latency_p50_ms=#{latencyP50Ms},latency_p95_ms=#{latencyP95Ms}, citation_accuracy=#{citationAccuracy},faithfulness=#{faithfulness},regression_verdict=#{regressionVerdict}, baseline_delta_json=CAST(#{baselineDeltaJson} AS JSON),gaps_json=CAST(#{gapsJson} AS JSON),finished_time=NOW() WHERE run_code=#{runCode}
UPDATE t_evaluation_run SET status='FAILED',error_message=#{errorMessage},finished_time=NOW() WHERE run_code=#{runCode}
mapper.select: SELECT id,run_code runCode,dataset_id datasetId,knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,status,mode,top_k topK, policy_version policyVersion,baseline_run_code baselineRunCode,case_count caseCount, hit_at1_rate hitAt1Rate,hit_at3_rate hitAt3Rate,hit_at5_rate hitAt5Rate,recall_at5 recallAt5,mrr,ndcg_at10 ndcgAt10, latency_p50_ms latencyP50Ms,latency_p95_ms latencyP95Ms,citation_accuracy citationAccuracy,faithfulness, regression_verdict regressionVerdict,baseline_delta_json baselineDeltaJson,gaps_json gapsJson, error_message errorMessage,started_time startedTime,finished_time finishedTime FROM t_evaluation_run WHERE run_code=#{runCode}

SELECT r.id,r.run_code runCode,r.dataset_id datasetId,r.knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,r.status,r.mode,r.top_k topK, r.policy_version policyVersion,r.baseline_run_code baselineRunCode,r.case_count caseCount, r.hit_at1_rate hitAt1Rate,r.hit_at3_rate hitAt3Rate,r.hit_at5_rate hitAt5Rate,r.recall_at5 recallAt5,r.mrr, r.ndcg_at10 ndcgAt10,r.latency_p50_ms latencyP50Ms,r.latency_p95_ms latencyP95Ms, r.citation_accuracy citationAccuracy,r.faithfulness,r.regression_verdict regressionVerdict, r.error_message errorMessage,r.started_time startedTime,r.finished_time finishedTime, d.name datasetName,d.dataset_code datasetCode FROM t_evaluation_run r LEFT JOIN t_evaluation_dataset d ON d.id=r.dataset_id WHERE r.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND r.dataset_id=#{datasetId} ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_evaluation_result(run_id,case_id,case_code,query_id,status,expected_codes_json,retrieved_codes_json, hit_at1,hit_at3,hit_at5,reciprocal_rank,recall_at5,ndcg_at10,latency_ms,citation_total,citation_hit,citation_accuracy,faithfulness,error_message) VALUES(#{runId},#{caseId},#{caseCode},#{queryId},#{status},CAST(#{expectedCodesJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{retrievedCodesJson} AS JSON), #{hitAt1},#{hitAt3},#{hitAt5},#{reciprocalRank},#{recallAt5},#{ndcgAt10},#{latencyMs},#{citationTotal},#{citationHit},#{citationAccuracy},#{faithfulness},#{errorMessage})
mapper.select: SELECT id,run_id runId,case_id caseId,case_code caseCode,query_id queryId,status, expected_codes_json expectedCodesJson,retrieved_codes_json retrievedCodesJson, hit_at1 hitAt1,hit_at3 hitAt3,hit_at5 hitAt5,reciprocal_rank reciprocalRank,recall_at5 recallAt5, ndcg_at10 ndcgAt10,latency_ms latencyMs,citation_total citationTotal,citation_hit citationHit, citation_accuracy citationAccuracy,faithfulness,error_message errorMessage,created_time createdTime FROM t_evaluation_result WHERE run_id=#{runId} ORDER BY id

SELECT knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,strategy, chunk_size chunkSize,chunk_overlap chunkOverlap,min_chunk_size minChunkSize,measure, keep_structure keepStructure,respect_sentence respectSentence,parent_child parentChild, updated_by updatedBy,updated_time updatedTime FROM t_chunk_policy WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_chunk_policy(knowledge_base_id,strategy,chunk_size,chunk_overlap, min_chunk_size,measure,keep_structure,respect_sentence,parent_child,updated_by) VALUES(#{kb},#{strategy},#{chunkSize},#{chunkOverlap},#{minChunkSize},#{measure}, #{keepStructure},#{respectSentence},#{parentChild},#{updatedBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE strategy=VALUES(strategy),chunk_size=VALUES(chunk_size), chunk_overlap=VALUES(chunk_overlap),min_chunk_size=VALUES(min_chunk_size),measure=VALUES(measure), keep_structure=VALUES(keep_structure),respect_sentence=VALUES(respect_sentence), parent_child=VALUES(parent_child),updated_by=VALUES(updated_by),updated_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_chunk_policy WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.document_id documentId, c.unit_code unitCode,c.parent_id parentId,c.heading_path headingPath, c.chunk_type chunkType,c.page_no pageNo,c.page_end pageEnd,c.char_start charStart, c.char_end charEnd,c.token_count tokenCount,c.content,c.content_hash contentHash, c.status,c.revision, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_content_unit x WHERE x.document_id=c.document_id AND x.id<=c.id) seq, doc.title documentTitle,doc.document_code documentCode, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_evidence e WHERE e.content_unit_id=c.id) evidenceCount FROM t_content_unit c LEFT JOIN t_document doc ON doc.id=c.document_id WHERE c.unit_code=#{code} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_source_version sv JOIN t_source s ON s.id=sv.source_id WHERE sv.id=doc.source_version_id AND s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb})

SELECT e.evidence_code evidenceCode, e.quote_text quoteText,e.location_json locationJson,e.authority_score authorityScore, e.freshness_score freshnessScore,e.created_time createdTime, s.name sourceName,s.source_code sourceCode, doc.title documentTitle,doc.document_code documentCode FROM t_evidence e JOIN t_content_unit c ON c.id=e.content_unit_id LEFT JOIN t_source s ON s.id=e.source_id LEFT JOIN t_document doc ON doc.id=c.document_id WHERE c.unit_code=#{code} AND e.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} ORDER BY e.id

(SELECT unit_code unitCode,'PREV' pos, heading_path headingPath,page_no pageNo,chunk_type chunkType,LEFT(content,180) excerpt FROM t_content_unit WHERE document_id=#{documentId} AND id<#{id} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT unit_code unitCode,'NEXT' pos, heading_path headingPath,page_no pageNo,chunk_type chunkType,LEFT(content,180) excerpt FROM t_content_unit WHERE document_id=#{documentId} AND id>#{id} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1)
